description: Potentiekaart Reststromen: Potentieel biogas & Potentieel houtachtige biomassa per gemeente (GJ/ha.jaar) is a dataset listed in National Georegister of the Netherlands, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by PDOK. This map shows the total potential for biogas production based on potential residual flows from Manure, Arable and Vegetable, Fruit and Garden Waste in GJ/(ha.year). Data by municipality. Coverage: NL. The portal shows the English title as "Potential card Residual flows: Potential biogas & Potential woody biomass per municipality (GJ/ha.year)" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-ngr-nl.
